amendment_history.reason: Superseded the bracketed moving-finalized-tag custody observation with a fresh EIP-1898 exact-block-hash acquisition and added raw-response semantic, exact OFAC-subject/control, and unsafe-path validation.

scope.purpose: Close the post-accession evidentiary review of title documentation, current custody, token-level approval state, and point-in-time exact-address sanctions screening without redating the original gift, title passage, or accession decision.

title_and_authority.determination_text: The donor made a full intentional gift of the seven exact tokens and all donor-held transferable interests, retained no donor interest, delivered the tokens, and the Museum formally accepted and accessioned them. The Museum treats that declaration, performance, acceptance, and its public title instrument as sufficient for this gift mode.
title_and_authority.copyright_boundary: Token title passed; Casey REAS's copyright did not. Museum uses remain governed by the reviewed object-specific CC BY-NC 4.0 conditions, legal exceptions or limitations, or later permission.
title_and_authority.restricted_annex_interpretation: The accession lot's public restricted_registrar_annex is an unused optional private-record stub. Its instrument_status=not_recorded describes the absence of a separate restricted annex; it does not describe TITLE-01, does not create an uncompleted title gate, and does not contradict the executed public title binding.
title_and_authority.signed_deed_boundary: No donor-signed deed or separate private title annex is represented as existing. The Museum did not require one for the recorded acceptance mode.
title_and_authority.accepted_residual_risk: Public chain evidence and the recorded gift declaration cannot disprove every private claim, incapacity, competing authority assertion, or off-chain dispute. The accession certificate already accepted that bounded residual risk; this review found no evidence requiring reconsideration.

custody_verification.finality_control: One provider returned the same finalized block number and hash before and after the observation window; every contract read on the second provider used an EIP-1898 selector containing that exact block hash with requireCanonical true.
custody_verification.evidence_boundary: The retained observations establish the queried contract state at the exact retained finalized block. They do not establish later custody, rule out approval-for-all operators, prove key security, or determine legal title by themselves.

sanctions_screening.authority: United States Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control, Sanctions List Service
sanctions_screening.method: Exact ID-number/digital-currency-address search through the official UI, minimum name score 100, all other filters blank or All; positive control required.
sanctions_screening.evidence_boundary: This is a point-in-time exact-address result, not a representation that a pseudonymous person is unsanctioned, a fuzzy name screen, identity verification, 50 Percent Rule analysis, transaction-exposure trace, or legal opinion.

reviewed_facts: The common inbound receipt successfully transferred the seven exact tokens from the recorded donor address to the Museum address.
All seven ownerOf calls returned the Museum address during the finalized-state audit window.
All seven token-specific getApproved calls returned the zero address during that window.
The ENS name resolved to the same Museum address during that window.
not_proven: absence of private liens, claims, contractual restrictions, incapacity, disputes, or key compromise
future custody or future sanctions-list status
encumbrance_and_control_review.risk_disposition: No observed fact requires a hold, deaccession review, title downgrade, or display restriction. The unobservable private-claim and operator-for-all boundaries remain accepted residual risks subject to standing custody monitoring.

standing_actions: Reverify custody before transfer, loan, exhibition relying on live ownership, or material publication refresh.
Repeat sanctions and counterparty diligence when a future acquisition, transfer, or newly identified material fact requires it.
Escalate any new title claim, sanctions match, unexpected approval, custody mismatch, or key-security concern for immediate registrar review.

non_claims: This review does not redate or replay the 2026-08-01 gift, token delivery, title passage, or accession event.
This review does not transfer a token, grant an approval, sign with a wallet, assign copyright, value the works, or create a commercial-use right.
No OpenSea or other marketplace rarity, ranking, valuation, title, compliance, or custody assertion is used.
